{{Top|leg}}
'''Holowan Terrace''' was a street of [[Kuat City]]. There was a street-level [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] stop along the street with the large mansion known as the [[House of Holowan]] one block north. From the hovertrain stop, it was possible to see the upper floors and the pyramid roof of the Holowan residence.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Adventures 5: The Shape-Shifter Strikes]]''
